Oceanic crust is 7 to 10 km thick, made of basalt, denser, and found on ocean floors.
Continental crust is 25 to 70 km thick, made of granite, less dense, and found on landmass

Subduction is the sideways and downward movement of a tectonic plate beneath another plate
A trench is a long narrow depression in the seafloor caused by subduction.
